messages:
olivia: quick sync on API Keys UI — updating create/rotate/revoke flows. prototype: https://redwood.internal/proto/keys-v4 :eyes:

olivia: priorities: make revoke harder to do accidentally, clearer scope labels, better empty-state guidance, and keyboard/a11y fixes for modals. need copy + interaction checks today.

raj: sounds good. product constraints: undo toast only for 30s; rotation keeps same key id (so references stay valid).

caroline: uploaded new modal frames. proposed copy:
- revoke CTA: "Revoke key" (danger)
- confirm: "This will immediately disable the key. Are you sure?"
- toast: "Key disabled. Undo"

matt: focus order bug: keyboard sequence is wrong in the confirm modal. correct order should be: heading -> description -> cancel -> confirm (confirm last). add aria-describedby linking to the description.

kevin: a11y checklist: add role=dialog, aria-modal=true, trap focus, and give destructive button an aria-label with key name, e.g. <button aria-label="Revoke key 'prod-main'">Revoke key</button>. make undo toast aria-live=polite.

design-bot: automated scan: low contrast detected on hint text in empty state. file #5432.

caroline: empty state copy options:
A) "No keys yet — create one to start calling the Redwood API."
B) "Create an API key to begin building — keep it secret."
Which for console vs docs?

raj: console: A (short + friendly). docs/onboarding: B.

olivia: scope presentation: show short pill in list, full scopes in a disclosure. avoid hover-only reveals.

matt: agree. disclosure button accessible pattern: button with aria-expanded and an associated region that toggles. on mobile, it should expand inline.

kevin: sample markup suggestion:
< button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="scopes-prod-main">Scopes: 2< /button>
< div id="scopes-prod-main" hidden>...< /div>
This keeps it keyboard operable and screen-reader friendly.

caroline: rotate modal copy:
- title: "Rotate key"
- body: "Rotation issues a new secret while keeping the same key id. Update configs that reference the secret."
- primary CTA: "Rotate and copy secret" (shows secret once)

matt: reveal should be masked with a copy button. copy triggers tooltip "Copied!" and logs analytics. also ensure tooltip is keyboard accessible.

kevin: masked field must include aria-describedby: "This secret will be shown only once." and not expose the secret to screen readers by default.

olivia: decisions: empty state = A, revoke copy as above, rotate copy as above, scopes = disclosure pill. any objections?

raj: +1

caroline: +1, will update Figma and attach final copy.

matt: +1; I'll file PR for focus order + disclosure behavior + undo toast.

kevin: +1; I'll add these checks to the a11y checklist and run smoke tests.

olivia: actions:
- caroline: update Figma + deliver copy snippets
- matt: implement focus-order changes, scope disclosure, undo toast (30s)
- kevin: a11y tests + checklist
- raj: docs updates for rotation tradeoffs

olivia: target: staging by EOD Friday. ping here with blocks. :rocket:

design-bot: note: contrast issue tracked (#5432).

matt: quick Q — undo window 30s or 60s? product asked 30s; UX prefers 60s.

raj: go with 30s for now, revisit if needed.

olivia: logged: undo window = 30s. thanks all! :raised_hands:
